provenance.author: BoardFlow
sources: Great Western Trail rulebook, first edition (eggertspiele, via RulesPal)

steps.text: Shuffle the station master tiles; one faceup on each of the 5 station master spaces
7 neutral building tiles on the neutral spaces: by matching letter A-G for a first game, random afterwards
Job market token on the top dashed space of the job market
Worker, teepee and hazard tiles facedown, sorted by the number on their backs (1, 2, 3) into three shuffled piles next to Kansas City
Reveal tiles with a 1 one by one onto the board until 7 are placed
Reveal tiles with a 2 into the job market: start under your player-count sign in the top row, fill rightwards and continue on the next row, up to the space left of the job market token
Each player takes a player board and their private building tiles, displayed in ascending order above it
steps.note: First games: all on the a-side. Later: one player randomizes sides and everyone copies

steps.text: 14 discs covering every colored disc space of your board (the 2 gray spaces stay empty)
Engine on the red starting building of the railroad track; certificate marker on the top space of your certificate track
Your 14 star-marked cattle cards shuffled as your draw stack left of your board
Shuffle the 4 starting objective cards; deal 1 faceup to each player; box the rest
Draw 4 cards; starting capital by turn order: 6, 7, 8, 9 dollars
First turn: place your cattleman on any neutral building tile and go straight to phase B
